summary:
Suppose that $G$ is a finite group, and let $A \subset G \times G$ be a subset of density $\alpha$.
Is it true that there are $\gg_\alpha |G|^3$ triples $x, y, g$ such that $(x, y), (gx, y), (x, gy)$
all lie in $A$?

Note: A is taken as $\alpha$-dense, i.e. $|A| \ge \alpha |G|^2$ [Au16, Question 2]

title: Green2.green_2
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ (A : Finset ℤ), A.card = n → ↑(Green2.maxRestrictedSumAvoidingSubsetSize A) ≥ Real.log ↑n ^ 100
summary:
Let $A \subset \mathbf{Z}$ be a set of $n$ integers. Is there a set $S \subset A$ of size
$(\log n)^{100}$ such that the restricted sumset$S \hat{+} S$ is disjoint from $A$?

title: Green24.variants.conjecture
statement: Green24.variants.gamma = 1 / 3
summary: Conjecture p.579 in [Aa19]: $\left(\frac{1}{3} + o(1)\right) n^2$.

title: Green32.green_32
statement: True ↔ Green32.HasLargeGapDilate fun p => √↑p
summary:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ be a set of size $\lfloor \sqrt{p} \rfloor$.
Is there a dilate of $A$ containing a gap of length $100\sqrt{p}$?

title: Green33.green_33
statement: True ↔ ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ᶠ (q : ℕ+) in Filter.atTop, ∃ A, A + A = Finset.univ ∧ |↑A.card / √↑↑q - √2| < ε
summary:
Are there infinitely many $q$ for which there is a set $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$,
$|A| = (\sqrt{2} + o(1))q^{1/2}$, with $A + A = \mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z}$? [Gr24]

title: Green36.green_36.variants.cks05
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ ε > 0,
    ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
      ∃ H x,
        ∃ (_ : Finite H),
          ∃ A B,
            ↑n ^ (2 - ε) ≤ ↑(Nat.card H) ∧
              ↑(Nat.card H) ≤ ↑n ^ (2 + ε) ∧
                (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑n ^ (2 - ε) ≤ ↑(A i).card * ↑(B i).card) ∧ Green36.SimultaneousDoubleProduct A B
summary: Variant using the exact simultaneous double product property from [CKS05, 4.1].

title: Green39.green_39
statement:
True ↔
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun p =>
      have k := (↑p).sqrt;
      have c := 100 * k;
      ↑(Green39.proportionCoverable (↑p) k c))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
summary:
If $A \subset \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ is random, $|A| = \sqrt{p}$, can we almost surely cover
$\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ with $100\sqrt{p}$ translates of $A$? [Gr24]

title: Green40.green_40
statement: True ↔ Filter.Tendsto Green40.f Filter.atTop (nhds ⊤)
summary: Does $f(r) \to \infty$? [Gr24]

display_title: Green's open problem 40 - f two eq one
title: Green40.green_40.f_two_eq_one
statement: True ↔ Green40.f 2 = 1
summary: It is not known whether f(2) = 1 [Gr24]

title: Green40.green_40.variants.arbitrary_subsets
statement: True ↔ Filter.Tendsto Green40.f_tilde Filter.atTop (nhds ⊤)
summary: Does $\tilde{f}(r) \to \infty$? [Gr24]

title: Green41.green_41.variants.polynomial_bound
statement: True ↔ ∃ C, ∃ ε₀ > 0, ∀ ε ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ε₀, ↑(Green41.minCopies ε) ≤ ε ^ (-C)
summary: Is $\varepsilon^{-C}$ rotations enough?

title: Green44.green_44
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (p : Fin 1000 → ℕ) (A : (i : Fin 1000) → Finset (ZMod (p i))),
    have remaining := {x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N | ∀ (i : Fin 1000), ↑x ∉ A i};
    (∀ (i : Fin 1000), Nat.Prime (p i)) →
      StrictMono p → p 999 ^ 10 < N ^ 9 → (∀ (i : Fin 1000), (A i).card = p i / 2) → 10 * remaining.card ≤ N
summary:
Sieve $[N]$ by removing half the residue classes mod $p_i$, for primes
$2 \leqslant p_1 < p_2 < \dots < p_{1000} < N^{9/10}$. Does the remaining set have size at most
$\frac{1}{10} N$?

We interpret "half the residue classes" as $\lfloor p_i / 2 \rfloor$.

title: Green47.green_47
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ (A : Set ℕ),
    (∀ᶠ (p : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, Nat.Prime p → ((fun a => ↑a) '' A).ncard ≤ (p + 1) / 2) →
      ((fun X => ↑(A ∩ Set.Iic X).ncard) =O[Filter.atTop] fun X => √↑X / Real.log ↑X ^ 100) ∨
        ∃ P, P.degree = 2 ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, ∃ z, ↑a = Polynomial.eval (↑z) P
summary:
Suppose that a large sieve process leaves a set of quadratic size. Is that set quadratic?

The following very particular instance is probably the simplest [Gr24]:
Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{N}$ is a set with the property that
$|A \pmod p| \leqslant \frac{1}{2}(p + 1)$ for all sufficiently large $p$.
Is it true that either $|A \cap [X]| \ll X^{1/2} / \log^{100} X$, or $A$ is contained in the
image of $\mathbb{Z}$ under a quadratic map $\phi : \mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{Q}$?

title: Green50.green_50
statement:
True ↔
  ∃ C > 0,
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Finset (𝔽₂ n)),
      A.Nonempty →
        have α := ↑A.dens;
        ∃ W v, v +ᵥ ↑W ⊆ ↑(10 • A) ∧ ↑n - C * Real.logb 2 (1 / α) ≤ ↑(Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ↥W)
summary:
Let $A \subset \mathbb{F}_2^n$ be a set of density $\alpha > 0$. Does $10A$ contain a coset
of some subspace of dimension at least $n - O(\log(1/\alpha))$?

More precisely: does there exist an absolute constant $C > 0$ such that for all $n \geq 1$ and all
nonempty $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_2^n$ with density $\alpha > 0$, the sumset $10A$ contains a coset
of some subspace of dimension at least $n - C \log_2(1/\alpha)$?

The sumset $10A$ is defined as $\{a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_{10} : a_i \in A\}$, using the pointwise
scalar multiplication notation `10 • A` where `•` denotes the iterated addition of a set.

Note: We model $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ as `Fin n → ZMod 2`, which is an $n$-dimensional vector space
over $\mathbb{F}_2$.

title: Green51.green_51.one_half
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ (k : ℝ),
    0 < k → ∃ c, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ α > 1 / 2 - k / √↑n, α ≤ 1 → n ≤ Green51.guaranteedMaxCosetDim n α + c
summary:
Suppose that $A \subset \mathbb{F}_2^n$ has density $\alpha > 1/2 - C/\sqrt{n}$.
Does $A + A$ contain a subspace of co-dimension $O_C(1)$? [Sa11, Question 5.1]

title: Green58.green_58
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    ∀ A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∀ B ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N, ↑N ^ 0.49 ≤ ↑A.card → ↑N ^ 0.49 ≤ ↑B.card → ∃ m ∈ A + B, m.Composite
summary:
Suppose $A, B ⊆ \{1, \dots, N\}$ both have size at least $N^{0.49}$. Must the sumset $A + B$
contain a composite number?

title: Green60.green_60
statement: True ↔ ∃ c > 0, ∀ (A : Finset ℕ), (∀ a ∈ A, IsSquare a) → 2 ≤ A.card → ↑(A + A).card ≥ ↑A.card ^ (1 + c)
summary:
Is there an absolute constant $c > 0$ such that, whenever $A ⊆ \mathbb{N}$ is a set of squares
with $|A| ≥ 2$, the sumset $A + A$ satisfies $|A + A| ≥ |A|^{1 + c}$?

title: Green62.green_62
statement:
True ↔
  ∀ᶠ (p : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
    Nat.Prime p →
      have A := Finset.filter Nat.Prime (Finset.range p);
      ∀ (x : ℕ), 1 ≤ x ∧ x < p → ∃ a₁ ∈ A, ∃ a₂ ∈ A, ↑x = ↑a₁ * ↑a₂
summary:
Let $p$ be a large prime, and let $A$ be the set of all primes less than $p$.
Is every $x \in \{1, \ldots, p-1\}$ congruent to some product $a_1 a_2$ where $a_1, a_2 \in A$?

title: Green66.green_66
statement: True ↔ ∀ᶠ (X : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ n, Green66.IsSumOfTwoSquares n ∧ ↑n ∈ Set.Icc (X - 1 / 10 * X ^ (1 / 4)) X
summary:
Is there always a sum of two squares between $X - \frac{1}{10}X^{1/4}$ and $X$?
We formalize this as an eventual statement for sufficiently large real $X$.

title: Green7.green_7.variants.positive_density
statement: True ↔ ∀ (a : ℕ → ℕ), Erdos342.IsUlamSequence a → (Set.range a).upperDensity > 0
summary: Does Ulam's sequence have positive density?

title: Green9.green_9_ii
statement: True ↔ ∃ c > 0, (fun N => ↑(Green9.r 5 N)) =O[Filter.atTop] fun N => ↑N * Real.log ↑N ^ (-c)
summary: Problem 9 (ii): is $r_5(N) \ll N(\log N)^{-c}$?

title: Green9.green_9_iii
statement: True ↔ ∃ c > 0, (fun n => ↑(Finset.maxAPFreeCard 4 Finset.univ)) =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => (5 ^ n) ^ (1 - c)
summary: Problem 9 (iii): is $r_4(\mathbf{F}_5^n) \ll N^{1-c}$, where $N=5^n$?
